text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Thank goodness it's nothing more than a scratch.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But… I'm sorry, I can't just sit quietly until I'm fully healed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I've got invitations from tons of people to go running tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And then I have a concert this weekend! I couldn't possibly be responsible for an empty seat in the audience!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: There's too much I wanna do to let this light injury hold me down!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Either way, I'm totally fine! I can totally move! Come on, let's get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: H-hey, come on! I said I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: There's training and simping to be done! I've got no time to rest!
choice_data_list: True, but you need your health for both!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uuugh… I can't really argue with that…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You're right… it's hard to have fun if I'm not healthy… Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Agnes Digital and I share some quiet time while I try to cheer her up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yay! That's my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Now, just you watch! ♪ An injury like this is nothing in the face of my love for Umas!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Aaarrrgh! It's no good!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ugh, and right after all my boasting… I guess I played myself…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's no fair… My plans with all the Umas… My concert… I wanna GOOO—ugh! Ouchie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital tries to push herself too hard and ends up making her injury worse.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer? I can move around just fine, right?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I guess you look okay.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yesss! All right! After training, I'm off to my concert, just as planned! Nothing can stand in my way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Agnes Digital successfully resumes training.
